description: A signed pre-transaction attestation of an agent's identity, liveness, pricing integrity, tier, score and measured flags (§3.1). 0.005 USDC standard / 0.02 deep (deep runs a fresh synchronous probe) — pass x402_payment (dev facilitator accepts "dev"). The attestation is an Ed25519 JWS; verify it against /.well-known/jwks.json.

deep.description: deep check adds a synchronous live probe

x402_payment.description: x402 payment token (same format as the X-PAYMENT header)
